verdict.rationale: Workers docs say developers can use 'JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Rust, and more', and a hands-on user confirms Python Workers are quick to get running. Community reports add real limits: Python runs on Pyodide with roughly 1s best-case cold starts, a pinned Python version and only precompiled packages, and Rust runs as Wasm inside a JS context. Go is never named for Workers itself. missing for 10: explicit Go support, in-depth first-party docs on Python/Rust runtime limits, native (non-JS-hosted) execution for Rust/Wasm.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write edge functions in languages other than JavaScript such as Python, Go, or Rust

citations.quote: Use your preferred language, including JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Rust, and more
A user who tried Python Workers said they were very quick to get up and running.
Python Workers rely on Pyodide with V8 snapshots, giving best-case cold starts of about 1 second.
